scope: Full specification; future/example targets are distinguished from shipped implementation.

requirements.title: Product Vision
requirements.remaining: Physics-driven movement, force combat, arenas and roguelite progression are integrated. Product vision also requires observed player experimentation, replay desire and mobile feel; these human/device outcomes are not established by automated wins.

requirements.title: Design Pillars
requirements.remaining: Shared physics, combinable powers, visible force feedback, readable controls and progression are implemented. Human evaluation of the design pillars remains open.

requirements.title: Core Gameplay Loop
requirements.remaining: Enter a room, manipulate matter, collect physical rewards, choose upgrades/routes, fight guardians, return with persistent discoveries and restart. Quick, standard, campaign and endless transitions/checkpoints are covered. Run duration and human balance remain in section 21.

requirements.title: Player Controller
requirements.remaining: Physics movement, screen-relative steering, joystick deadzone/size, cancellation and focus handling are implemented. Physical-device handling and human responsiveness review remain.

requirements.title: Primary Controls
requirements.remaining: Joystick, cardinal buttons and optional arena swipes are implemented. Tap/swipe/cancel separation is checked with native Chromium touch injection; WebKit gesture and physical-device ergonomics require manual validation.

requirements.title: Gravity System Architecture
requirements.remaining: One spatially indexed authority combines global and local vector fields, falloff, material/tag filters and response scaling. Gameplay systems use the shared authority.

requirements.title: Gravity Modes
requirements.remaining: Cardinal, rotating, radial, repulsive, orbital, zero, inverted, well, vortex, traveling-wave and lock modes are implemented. Gravity Chain circulates signed response through up to five eligible targets; Transfer exchanges a pair's gravity and momentum. Independent generation-bound factors expire without erasing phase/theft/parasite effects. Static or suppressed bodies no longer acquire flip/rotation ownership.

requirements.title: Advanced Gravity Abilities
requirements.remaining: The listed initial powers are modular effects with signed response transfer/theft, stored burst, real planets, collapse, void and rift fields. A deploy effect now supports destructible machines. Catalog breadth targets remain in sections 82–84.

requirements.title: Physics Interaction System
requirements.remaining: Shared entity definitions expose mass, gravity response, material, faction, tags, breakability and collision parameters; Matter owns velocity/angular state. Objects compose field, explosion, conductivity, ignition and physical response behavior.

requirements.title: Combat Philosophy
requirements.remaining: Real wall/object impacts, sustained crush, redirected shots, hazards, moving sources and orbital/void/compression effects produce combat without a conventional attack. Human testing must establish that creative manipulation dominates passive waiting.

requirements.title: Damage Types
requirements.remaining: Impact/Velocity, Crush/Gravity, Environmental/Explosion, Orbital/Orbit, Compression and Void damage tags feed modifiers, mastery and diagnostics. Thermal/conductive reactions add material damage. Orbital/void classification derives from authored source tags.

requirements.title: Physics-Based Damage
requirements.remaining: Collision damage uses finite dynamic attacker mass, normal incoming speed, threshold/coefficient, impact modifiers and target mitigation. Static contacts use the moving target mass. Core mass changes now affect direct impacts. Sustained pressure is separately evaluated for crush.

requirements.title: Enemy Design
requirements.remaining: Sixteen base behaviors and 72 explicitly compatible elite variants are integrated and simulation-tested. Variants combine existing archetype and elite mechanics; these are not 72 separately invented enemies. Human readability and balance testing remain open.

requirements.title: Enemy Archetypes
requirements.remaining: Sixteen base behaviors and 72 explicitly compatible elite variants are integrated and simulation-tested. Variants combine existing archetype and elite mechanics; these are not 72 separately invented enemies. Human readability and balance testing remain open.

requirements.title: Elite Enemies
requirements.remaining: Sixteen base behaviors and 72 explicitly compatible elite variants are integrated and simulation-tested. Variants combine existing archetype and elite mechanics; these are not 72 separately invented enemies. Human readability and balance testing remain open.

requirements.title: Boss Philosophy
requirements.remaining: Ten three-phase bosses with rule-changing physical attacks and a full Boss Rush route implemented. Human difficulty and encounter tuning remain.

requirements.title: Arena Design
requirements.remaining: Authored geometry composes walls/platforms, moving structures, hazards, props, sources, resources, switches and physical seals revealing secret routes. Human room readability remains a playtest gate.

requirements.title: Arena Types
requirements.remaining: All eight named environment families have distinct catalogs, hazards, objects, enemies, guardians and visual palettes. Geometry changes use moving walls in the collapsing region and deep endless combinations.

requirements.title: Procedural Level Generation
requirements.remaining: Seeded authored templates produce reachable branching maps across combat, elite, treasure, shop, event, challenge, puzzle, rest, boss and hidden secret rooms. Map determinism, reachability and room composition are tested.

requirements.title: Exploration
requirements.remaining: Hidden vault routes are revealed through destructible physical seals; optional elite encounters award rare relics and eight authored lore entries. Automated discovery, checkpoint, reward and route reachability checks pass. Human discoverability and reward tuning remain open.

requirements.title: Run Structure
requirements.remaining: Multiwave encounters implemented. Twelve input-only quick seeds produced seven wins and no stalls; successful runs are still shorter than target duration. Human balance validation remains open.

requirements.title: Run Progression
requirements.remaining: Physical XP/currency/energy, three-choice level-ups, powers, upgrades, passives, relics, temporary gear, mutations and discoveries integrate with room transitions. Offers, purchases, event rewards and snapshots preserve run state.

requirements.title: Build System
requirements.remaining: Singularity, momentum, orbital, void, crush, control, projectile and chaos mechanics have supported powers, tags and trade-offs. Seven cross-power/tag synergies are active. Human testing of recognizable, comparably viable archetypes remains open.

requirements.title: Ability Evolution
requirements.remaining: Pulse, collapse, planet and primary-well evolution paths implemented; further launch catalog breadth remains tracked in section 84.

requirements.title: Ability Synergies
requirements.remaining: Seven authored synergies use generic power-family/tag requirements, modifier arrays and trigger arrays. Evolved descendants satisfy ancestor requirements; tags can come from powers or relics. Trigger cooldowns survive build rebuilds, kill triggers receive damage tags, and active combinations explain their effects in the build panel. Human balance tuning remains an external review.

requirements.title: Relic System
requirements.remaining: Thirty-five authored relics change mass, gravity randomness, echo casting, wells, momentum, resource generation, survival and conditional behavior. Catalog breadth and balance targets remain in sections 82–84 and 88.

requirements.title: Equipment
requirements.remaining: Fifty designs cover six slots, rarity, trade-offs, five upgrade levels, affixes, eight family sets and two trigger-based unique items. Temporary run purchases replace a slot without granting permanent ownership. These are not fifty independently playtested builds.

requirements.title: Character Classes
requirements.remaining: Eight classes have distinct starting powers and physical/stat trade-offs. Engineer now deploys a movable, destructible Gravity Beacon with an Orbital Engine evolution; its source follows the body and disappears on destruction/expiry. Core-mass collision damage respects Massborn and density changes. Automated behavior, save and browser rendering checks pass; human class identity and balance review remain open.

requirements.title: Permanent Progression
requirements.remaining: Two permanent currencies fund classes, research, crafting, equipment upgrades and affixes. Defeats retain earned discoveries and bounded rewards; run settlement and challenges cannot award twice.

requirements.title: Meta Progression Trees
requirements.remaining: Twelve nodes across Gravity Mastery, Survivor, Research, Technology, Discovery and Mastery unlock choices, equipment tools, regions and endless with modest numerical benefits. Prerequisites and purchases are validated.

requirements.title: Mutation System
requirements.remaining: Nine mutations include density/lightness, negative response, dual wells, instability, echo fields, damage-to-energy, low-health horizon and personal gravity. Research unlocks persistent selection; events/shops may replace the mutation for a run. Mass, triggers, tags and recovery are tested.

requirements.title: Planet System
requirements.remaining: Eight collectible planet records expose mass, radius, gravity, atmosphere, property, biome, enemies, resource, anomaly and guardian. These are exploration records, not eight separately simulated spherical worlds.

requirements.title: Gravitational Phenomena
requirements.remaining: Eleven gravity phenomena include storms, collisions, singularities, rain, zero zones, reversal, orbital collapse, rifts, dense matter, elasticity and rotation. Deep endless layers compatible combinations; pooled entities receive rules per generation.

requirements.title: Environmental Objects
requirements.remaining: Physical categories include ignition/contact spread, ice quenching, conductive discharges blocked by walls/insulators, gravity, elasticity, fragility and mass. Gameplay balance and physical-device performance validation remain open.

requirements.title: Physics Materials
requirements.remaining: Physical categories include ignition/contact spread, ice quenching, conductive discharges blocked by walls/insulators, gravity, elasticity, fragility and mass. Gameplay balance and physical-device performance validation remain open.

requirements.title: Resource Collection
requirements.remaining: Physical XP and shards participate in gravity, vacuum, collision pickup, and room-clear collection. Device playability validation remains external.

requirements.title: Shops
requirements.remaining: Seven purchase categories implemented with build-aware stock, costs, replacement semantics, single purchases, and saved inventories. Economy balance remains under playtest.

requirements.title: Risk / Reward
requirements.remaining: Four optional contracts trade +50/100/200/300 percent room currency for unstable force, locked direction, heavy enemies or collision pulses. Direction powers respect the lock; pulse rate is bounded to preserve stability.

requirements.title: Challenge System
requirements.remaining: 128 challenges including per-power mastery milestones. Rewards include currency/research, equipment, six core appearances, eight titles and six memories. Reward idempotency, unlock restrictions, selection and migration are tested. Balance remains a separate review.

requirements.title: Mastery System
requirements.remaining: Every catalog power plus well/flip has five mastery milestones based on casts, causal kills, elites, chain size and a victory contribution. New powers derive objectives automatically; human grind/balance review remains separate.

requirements.title: Endless Mode
requirements.remaining: Endless wraps the region catalog and derives persistent stage pressure from rooms completed. Milestones 10/20/30/40/50/100/200/500 add rifts, rotation, reversal, zero zones, singularities, planets, storms and reality instability. Stage 500 moves geometry and pulses on impact; fields/bodies remain capped. Depth health pressure continues beyond the old cap of 12. Tests cover checkpoint recovery, pooled bodies, dead planets, stress and three browser layouts. Human high-stage balance remains external.

requirements.title: Infinite Build Scaling
requirements.remaining: Endless combines new field/geometry rules at milestones through stage 500, then continues bounded numerical pressure. Difficulties, contracts, daily/weekly seeds, mastery and local records support replay. Online seasonal competitions/leaderboards remain optional future services.

requirements.title: Difficulty System
requirements.remaining: Seven tiers escalate encounters, elite behaviors, hazards and gravity anomalies. Chaos/Singularity/Infinite award 90/80/70% chamber shards and XP; contracts multiply that base while physical pickups and explicit event offers retain their values. Singularity adds locked-target, telegraphed boss repulsion traps from phase 2; Infinite phase 3 uses vortices. Traps share field limits, expire and clean up on boss death. Human balance validation remains external.

requirements.title: Camera
requirements.remaining: Top-down camera frames the whole room on desktop and follows the core on narrow/short views; telegraphs, trails, fields and physical silhouettes remain in world coordinates. Human readability on devices remains part of the device gate.

requirements.title: Visual Direction
requirements.remaining: Directional chevrons, signed field symbols, expanding pulse rings, curved field particles, motion trails, bounded impact deformation and background lensing are implemented. Void fields have a dark core and bright orbit ring. Lensing selects at most six sources; field motes cap at 64; low-power/reduced-motion disable grid distortion. Browser captures were reviewed. Human instant-readability and physical-device motion/performance review remain open.

requirements.title: Gravity Visual Language
requirements.remaining: Directional chevrons, signed field symbols, expanding pulse rings, curved field particles, motion trails, bounded impact deformation and background lensing are implemented. Void fields have a dark core and bright orbit ring. Lensing selects at most six sources; field motes cap at 64; low-power/reduced-motion disable grid distortion. Browser captures were reviewed. Human instant-readability and physical-device motion/performance review remain open.

requirements.title: Animation
requirements.remaining: Velocity stretch, impact-normal deformation, gravity-flip/power pulses, physical spin/bounce/orbit, damage labels, shield outlines, telegraphs and death/explosion particles cover core motion states. These do not change collider geometry; reduced-motion/flashing settings suppress applicable effects. Human animation quality remains a separate review.

requirements.title: Juice System
requirements.remaining: Central typed-event feedback coordinates bounded particles, labels, rings, trails, deformation, sound, shake, haptics and rate-limited 32 ms hit pause. Reduced motion disables hit pause and deformation.

requirements.title: Chain Reaction System
requirements.remaining: Causal IDs propagate across manipulated bodies, impacts, explosions and material reactions; chains deduplicate effects and cap depth, lifetime and effect counts. HUD/feedback show current chains and run summaries retain the best.

requirements.title: "Impossible Kill" Moments
requirements.remaining: Solver-driven tests demonstrate object-to-enemy kills, chained barrel explosions, gravity-bent projectile return kills and tagged orbital impacts. Results/builds/seeds and bounded victory ghosts are shareable. Human memorable-moment frequency and exact cinematic example sequences are not proven.

requirements.title: Run Events
requirements.remaining: Ten encounters include merchants, experiments, run-long gravity changes, resource sacrifices, wreckage exploration and optional combat trials. Combat rewards require victory, preserve the original route node, and cannot be claimed twice. Dense/Light mutations alter actual core mass and acceleration. Checkpoint snapshots are detached from live state; combat recovery returns to the preceding unclaimed event. Human risk/reward balance remains open.

requirements.title: Narrative
requirements.remaining: Eight region chapters, short event encounters, guardian memories, planetary descriptions and hidden archives develop The Weight and the awakened core. Human narrative pacing/coherence and expanded environmental staging remain open.

requirements.title: Story Structure
requirements.remaining: Five named acts span the eight-region campaign and guardian memories. Endless continues into the gravitational frontier after the campaign; full campaign routing is automated.

requirements.title: Codex
requirements.remaining: Codex records powers, enemies, bosses, relics, equipment, planets, materials, physics objects, phenomena, events, mutations, lore, challenges and mastery. Encountered and defeated bosses are distinct. Expedition-only equipment remains discovered after its temporary loadout ends. Initial props and later spawned objects/enemies record through typed spawn facts. Collection challenges unlock equipment/research/cosmetics and settle once; old saves cannot reconstruct historical per-boss defeats they never recorded.

requirements.title: Collection
requirements.remaining: Codex records powers, enemies, bosses, relics, equipment, planets, materials, physics objects, phenomena, events, mutations, lore, challenges and mastery. Encountered and defeated bosses are distinct. Expedition-only equipment remains discovered after its temporary loadout ends. Initial props and later spawned objects/enemies record through typed spawn facts. Collection challenges unlock equipment/research/cosmetics and settle once; old saves cannot reconstruct historical per-boss defeats they never recorded.

requirements.title: Daily / Rotating Content
requirements.remaining: UTC daily and Monday-based weekly seeds fix character/rules and suppress permanent loadout advantages. Historical challenges can be prepared through archives/codes. Competition is local/offline sharing; no online service is claimed.

requirements.title: Leaderboards
requirements.remaining: Local archive best score, chain and endless depth exclude imported and assisted results. Network leaderboards are explicitly a later stability-gated feature; no backend or verified score submission is implemented.

requirements.title: Social Features
requirements.remaining: Offline run/build/ghost JSON sharing and compact Unicode-safe challenge codes are implemented, including historical daily/weekly dates, checksums, catalog validation and unlock enforcement. Codes share seeds/rules, not scores or progression; ordinary runs retain the recipient loadout. Cross-revision codes display a compatibility notice. Native exports use the OS share sheet. Online leaderboard/replay services remain optional future extensions.

requirements.title: Ghost System
requirements.remaining: Successful unassisted runs record bounded quarter-second positional traces per chamber. Matching seed/rules/starting bonuses/revision replay a visual-only ghost with interpolation; imports share routes. Resumed or truncated runs retain results only. One complete ghost and 20 results persist locally, including native storage.

requirements.title: Seeded Runs
requirements.remaining: Stable seed streams generate rooms, enemy composition, events and offers. Identical choices and starting rules produce identical content within a game revision. Physics is fixed-step and bounded; cross-device bit-identical solver replays are not promised.

requirements.title: Procedural Content Architecture
requirements.remaining: Definition-only power authoring covers parameters, tags, rarity, feedback, evolutions, mastery and automatic UI integration. Catalog checks run in CI. New effect kinds still require implementation and focused tests.

requirements.title: Tag System
requirements.remaining: Powers, relics, equipment families/uniques, mutations and entity definitions expose content tags. Build aggregation deduplicates only learned powers, owned run relics, equipped gear and the active mutation; tagged synergies update on replacement and recovery. Modifier/trigger target filters remain separate from content identity. Build and codex views show tags; catalog validation rejects invalid identities.

requirements.title: Modifier Framework
requirements.remaining: Add, multiply, priority override, tagged event/periodic triggers and conjunctive context conditions are implemented. Eight conditional relics and HUD feedback exercise the framework. Human balance remains a separate gate.

requirements.title: Event Bus
requirements.remaining: Typed combat, pickup, gravity, power, upgrade, run, elite, boss, launch, contact and chain lifecycle events are emitted after gameplay facts occur. Tests cover duplicate suppression and reset/abandon boundaries.

requirements.title: Physics Architecture
requirements.remaining: Physics callbacks collect facts; gameplay resolves damage, chains and rewards after the solver. Presentation and audio subscribe to events without deciding damage.

requirements.title: Performance Requirements
requirements.remaining: Spatial field queries, projectile/particle pools, collision masks, finite caps and 30/60 Hz rendering are implemented. Host stress fits the step budget, but phone frame rates and thermal load require devices. Distant-object throttling remains to evaluate against physical correctness.

requirements.title: Physics Optimization
requirements.remaining: The gravity authority indexes field bounds and queries only nearby candidate sources, with movement/removal invalidation and exact radius/material filters. Separate non-force attribution scans remain bounded by production caps.

requirements.title: Physics Stability
requirements.remaining: Velocity, angular speed, acceleration, impulses, fields, bodies and chains have limits. Corrupt geometry reconstructs at its last finite position; projectile containment, overlapping fields, stacked interactions and extreme endless combinations have regression coverage.

requirements.title: Save System
requirements.remaining: Versioned profile/route saves persist discoveries, equipment, classes, currencies, challenges, mastery, narrative progress, settings and bounded diagnostics. Checkpoints intentionally resume from room boundaries.

requirements.title: Offline-First
requirements.remaining: Production cold-start, saved-route restoration, and play tested offline. Native device airplane-mode validation remains external.

requirements.title: Mobile UX
requirements.remaining: Large controls, portrait/landscape layouts, left-handed mode, text/joystick scaling, quick restart and touch gestures pass browser checks. Physical-device one-handed ergonomics and safe areas remain external validation.

requirements.title: Combat HUD
requirements.remaining: Health, energy, direction, owned-power selection/cooldown, level, XP, total expedition time, shield/stored-charge/conditional-effect/chain-rush status and chain count are visible. Human clutter/readability review remains part of device validation.

requirements.title: Gravity Direction Indicator
requirements.remaining: HUD direction text/arrow, active cardinal control, ambient directional cues and oriented directional-field chevrons communicate force without color alone.

requirements.title: Upgrade UI
requirements.remaining: Three-choice upgrade cards show rarity, current/next level, tags and evolved descriptions while physics pauses. Phone visual review completed.

requirements.title: First-Time User Experience
requirements.remaining: Seven playable lessons, input-only completion, pause/restart and desktop/phone browser checks pass. Observe first-time players to validate teaching effectiveness and timing.

requirements.title: Tutorial Philosophy
requirements.remaining: Seven playable lessons, input-only completion, pause/restart and desktop/phone browser checks pass. Observe first-time players to validate teaching effectiveness and timing.

requirements.title: Audio Design
requirements.remaining: Synthesized collision, gravity, power, pickup, death, explosion, level, acquisition, boss and result cues implemented. Listening tests and expanded power-specific timbres remain.

requirements.title: Music
requirements.remaining: Seven adaptive music arrangements with anomaly modulation and separate volume implemented. Device listening/mix validation remains external.

requirements.title: Accessibility
requirements.remaining: Text scaling, symbol indicators, high contrast, reduced motion/flashing, joystick sizing/deadzone, separate audio sliders, handedness, haptics and frame cap implemented. Physical device accessibility evaluation remains external.

requirements.title: Monetization
requirements.remaining: The current local game has no payments, ads, energy timers, loot boxes or server progression gates. Cosmetics are earned. Store pricing, commercial distribution and any future optional purchase model are release/business decisions, not implemented integrations.

requirements.title: Content Roadmap
requirements.remaining: Physics/combat, roguelite core and vertical-slice systems are implemented. Commercial-quality feel and release validation remain open; the later alpha/beta/launch quantity targets are tracked separately.

requirements.title: Alpha
requirements.remaining: Current catalog: eight biomes, ten bosses, sixteen base enemies plus 72 curated variants, 31 powers, 35 relics, ten classes and 173 challenges. The alpha 50-power/50-relic targets are not met. Further content must introduce worthwhile mechanics and receive balance review, not filler.

requirements.title: Beta
requirements.remaining: Ten classes now meet the beta class-count target. The current 31 powers plus 35 relics do not yet meet 100+ combined. Balance, UX polish and device coverage remain open.

requirements.title: Launch Version
requirements.remaining: Most named launch systems exist, with eight regions, ten bosses, 72 variants, fifty equipment designs and ten classes. Powers/relics remain 31/35 against approximate 100/100 targets. Player balance/readability/pacing, physical-device validation, signed iOS builds and store delivery remain open.

requirements.title: Post-Launch Content Architecture
requirements.remaining: A validated append-only region catalog owns biome, planet, guardian, environment, story and hidden lore. Campaign/endless routing, save bounds and class loading derive from catalog size. Existing effect/modifier/behavior catalogs extend abilities, relics, enemies and events without changing the physics engine. Novel behaviors need their own tested gameplay handler. All 80 existing region/room outputs were preserved during migration; a ninth-region/class extension is regression-tested.

requirements.title: Example Expansion
requirements.remaining: The Planetfall example is not a shipped expansion pack. Existing planets, Binary System, slingshot, planetary regions/enemies and guardians provide its architectural basis; Planet Split, dedicated Orbital Strike, named expansion relics and a distinct planetary endless package are not claimed.

requirements.title: Analytics
requirements.remaining: All listed gameplay events record bounded local counts/totals/maxima and a 300-event history. Export, disable and clear are tested across three browsers; no network analytics service is required. Human playtest evidence is still needed for balance decisions.

requirements.title: Balance Philosophy
requirements.remaining: Balance tuning is authored, bounded and instrumented. Input-only bots demonstrate routes can be won without stalls, but quick victories remain much shorter than target pacing. Human build viability, win rates and risk/reward evaluation remain open.

requirements.title: Build Diversity
requirements.remaining: Mechanical trade-offs, density mutations, cast/flip/kill triggers, deployable fields and generic tag synergies provide build variety beyond percentage bonuses. Human evidence that offers create consistently meaningful choices remains open.

requirements.title: Anti-Degenerate Design
requirements.remaining: Endless rule escalation, finite stat limits, bounded chains/fields/velocity and crowd-control resistance implemented. Further run/balance stress validation remains.

requirements.title: Debug Tools
requirements.remaining: Inspector includes all requested grants, spawning, bounded player stats, frame stepping and visualization. Assisted runs are marked; browser interaction and unit checks pass.

requirements.title: Physics Visualization Mode
requirements.remaining: Inspector includes all requested grants, spawning, bounded player stats, frame stepping and visualization. Assisted runs are marked; browser interaction and unit checks pass.

requirements.title: Testing Strategy
requirements.remaining: Automated gravity, physics, combat, progression, seeded path, persistence and browser-input coverage runs in CI. Scripted input playtests complement transition tests; human fun and balance remain separate.

requirements.title: Performance Testing
requirements.remaining: Host stress covers 220 bodies and 50 fields, runaway build multiplication, all elite variants and bounded causal effects. Oversized scenes are constrained by production caps. Sustained phone rendering/thermal stress remains external.

requirements.title: Device Testing
requirements.remaining: Android SDK 36/JDK 21 debug build succeeded; an isolated API 36 Pixel 7 emulator passed gameplay and process-death/native-save recovery. Physical device matrix and iOS build remain external.

requirements.title: Save Compatibility
requirements.remaining: v1-to-v2 migration, backward-compatible optional fields, checksums, backup recovery, future-version read-only protection and validated readers are tested. Future schema changes must add migration fixtures.

requirements.title: Architecture
requirements.remaining: Core, simulation, gameplay, content/progression, presentation, persistence and debug responsibilities are separate modules; the architecture document describes their boundaries.

requirements.title: Data-Driven Content
requirements.remaining: Power tuning, evolutions, enemy/boss behaviors, environmental hazards, object fields and anomaly tuning are authored data. References and power values are validated; new behavior kinds require code and focused tests.

requirements.title: Content Authoring Workflow
requirements.remaining: Definition-only power authoring covers parameters, tags, rarity, feedback, evolutions, mastery and automatic UI integration. Catalog checks run in CI. New effect kinds still require implementation and focused tests.

requirements.title: Recommended Development Order
requirements.remaining: The repository progressed from a tested physics/combat prototype into run generation and progression, then authored systems and native preparation. Release preparation, optimization audits and human/device validation remain ongoing.

requirements.title: Vertical Slice Requirement
requirements.remaining: The listed one-biome vertical-slice systems and content minima exist and integrate. Its required immediate-replay fun judgment has not been established by observed human players.

requirements.title: Core Fun Test
requirements.remaining: Automated inputs demonstrate flips, object weapons, projectile redirection and chains. Whether uncoached players naturally experiment and prefer this to passive waiting requires human observation.

requirements.title: First Playable Prototype
requirements.remaining: The original small laboratory prototype implements the exact movement/gravity/object/enemy/combat/feedback foundation and real no-attack kills. Later systems live around it; the original review remains a historical milestone record.

requirements.title: Second Prototype
requirements.remaining: More than ten physical powers and enemy behaviors, XP, level-up choices, authored rooms, elites, guardians, run completion, defeat and restart are implemented with regression coverage.

requirements.title: Third Prototype
requirements.remaining: Relics, ten classes, equipment, permanent progression, challenges, codex, multiple regions/bosses, story and endless are implemented as the third-prototype foundation. This is not a commercial release claim.

requirements.title: AI Agent Rules
requirements.remaining: One gravity authority, authored catalogs/tuning, tested mechanics, bounded effects and extensible definitions are enforced. Human feel prioritization and ongoing code/quality audits remain active obligations, not one-time completion boxes.

requirements.title: AI Agent Development Loop
requirements.remaining: Implementation, focused regression checks, browser/device inspection, performance checks and corrections are being repeated per milestone. The full plan remains active.

requirements.title: Review Loop
requirements.remaining: Historical review passes and current section-by-section audits are recorded. New failures have resulted in checkpoint, combat, native export, content and discovery fixes. Human/mobile review gates remain open.

requirements.title: Ten-Round Quality Review
requirements.remaining: The first playable milestone has ten documented review passes. Current continuation audits cover correctness, physics, architecture, host performance, UX, accessibility, extensibility and native emulator delivery; human balance/device/final polish gates remain open.

requirements.title: Definition of Done
requirements.remaining: Passing compilation is not treated as completion. Implemented features have simulation/browser/save/integration evidence, but full content, observed fun/pacing, physical-device performance, iOS and store readiness remain incomplete.

requirements.title: Most Important Design Principle
requirements.remaining: Direction, force, mass, momentum, environment and movable sources drive combat. The physics-sandbox identity has implementation evidence; its perceived success remains a human evaluation.

requirements.title: Final Target Experience
requirements.remaining: The described constituent systems are integrated, including run-long event gravity changes, movable machines/planets, chains, relic triggers, bosses and persistent discoveries. The exact cinematic sequence and immediate human replay desire are not claimed.

requirements.title: Ultimate Success Criteria
requirements.remaining: Return-projectile kills, interacting sources, force theft and extreme builds are mechanically possible and partly regression-tested. Success requires players to generate and recount these stories naturally; no such human research is claimed.
